## 席位核对

**L1 verdict: ACCEPT** · PR #34551 · card #34461 · first review · read 2026-11-17T01:24Z

Head-sha: `2daa63fe57f8c88dc20e1e4538807773bfbc510f` (the head named in final-head comment 6934850770)

Read from GitHub at this head (`get_files`, diff, check-runs), not from the report.

**Checklist**
- Shape: draft, base `main`. The body opens with the attribution lines and then `Fixes #34461`, and the whole card is delivered. #34462, named in the body, has no closing verb next to it.
- Scope: 7 files, all under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/`, plus a root changeset. They are `outboundAgentText.ts` (new `ATTACHMENT_NOTE_TEXT` table, `resolveAttachmentNoteText`, `joinAttachmentNames`), `chatAttachments.ts`, `AiChatPage.tsx` `prepareTurn`, one new pin file, and two existing pins changed. No `content/docs/releases/`.
- `Clause-②: no` holds. No locale-pack key is added: the table lives in the module, not a pack, so no published `TranslationKeys` surface moves. The exported helpers are app-shell internals, and `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`.
- Changeset: root, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`. I checked each sentence against the diff:
  - "the spreadsheet brief …, the line naming the images and PDFs sent as files, and each 'not read' line" matches the nine keys of `AttachmentNoteKey`, one per old hard-coded Chinese string. The zh column is byte-identical to the removed literals, including the `、` separator kept as `NAME_SEPARATOR.zh`.
  - "a turn written in Chinese gets Chinese notes, any other gets English ones, and a turn with files but no words takes the language the conversation is held in" matches `prepareTurn`: `isConversationZh([{ role: 'user', content }])` when there are words, else the thread probe `isConversationZh(runtimeMessages) || isConversationZh(initialMessages)`, which is the same expression as the page's `convZh`.
  - "the same rule every other piece of text the console sends the agent follows": `detectConversationLanguage` reads the latest user turn with words, and the turn being prepared becomes that turn, so the two agree.
  - "A turn with no attachment is sent exactly as typed" matches the synchronous `doSend` branch, which is untouched, and the CONTROL pin.
- Tests: the new pin file has four cases: an English turn, a Chinese turn, files with no words, and a CONTROL with no attachment. The final-head comment records ablation A3 re-run at this head (the no-words branch forced to `false`, 1 red). Two existing pins changed their expectations from Chinese to English: the #32749 file (its turns are typed in English, as the header now says) and one line of the #34462 file. Both encode the old always-Chinese behaviour this card retires. They are replaced, not deleted, and still assert each note's content.
- Gates: 51 check-runs on this head, all `completed`: 38 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates `success`, TypeScript Type Check `success`, Lint UI `success`, Type Check UI `success`, Test UI `success`.

**Spot checks (mine)**
1. Nothing else reads the old Chinese markers. A `git grep` at this head for `附件表格`, `内容未读取`, `已作为文件随本条消息` and `一次最多读取` outside `outboundAgentText.ts` and the tests finds nothing, so no agent prompt, skill or server parser keyed on the Chinese text.
2. `threadMessagesRef` is refreshed every render and read only inside `prepareTurn`. So the callbacks keep their identity (deps stay `[upload]`) and the probe reads the thread as it stands when the turn is prepared. `convZh` keeps its single reader, which is why `console-namespace-3546.test.tsx` went green at this head.
3. `sentText` (what `onSent` is told) still includes the sheet brief, now in the turn's language, and still excludes the file notes, as #34462 left it.

**Deviation, for the area before ready (no head move needed)**: the PR body was written at the first head `6be60bcd`, and its two lines saying the page's `convZh` is read through a ref are now false. The body's own Acceptance-notes rule is that comment 6934850770 supersedes them, but the body is what a reader of the merged PR sees. Please correct those two lines in the body (an edit, no push) when the six quick-read lines are finalised for landing.

**L2 owed: no.** None of the four contract faces is touched: `Clause-②: no`, no narrowing, no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no governed rule text.

**Landing tier**: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34551` reports NOT governed, +418/−32 = 450 lines ≤ 3000. Ordinary queue landing by the area at this head.
